# Packaging and release (area `release`)

Building and signing FERB.app and DMGs, versions, appcasts, release checks, the logo assets and the public site.

Active decisions here. Run `tools/kb/run kb show <file>` for the ones governing one file, their tests and open work; never reword an owner decision (supersede it).

- **REL-1** (owner): FERB's one logo is the extension's: the dark rounded square with the white "f" and the orange dot, unchanged in look, used by the app, the site, the extension and everywhere else.
- **REL-2** (owner): A release refuses a version that is a .dev one, not newer than the last v* tag on origin, or not the tag's, and one whose extension the Chrome Web Store doesn't serve yet (MIN_EXTENSION_VERSION). Tests keep ferb/__init__.py and pyproject.toml equal and the repo's extension at or above MIN_EXTENSION_VERSION. The version stays 0.27.0.dev1 for now.
- **REL-3** (agent): assets/logo/ferb-logo.svg is the one master (128-unit canvas, the 96-unit square inset 16; the "f" an outline path, so nothing depends on installed fonts). Change the logo only there, then run `uv run python scripts/make_logo.py`, which rewrites every derived file (PNG, AppIcon.icns, extension and notch SVGs and PNGs, site favicon and touch icon) with macOS's own renderer and iconutil. Derived files are committed, so builds don't render.
- **REL-4** (agent): FERB.app and its helper name CFBundleIconFile AppIcon; build-app.sh copies the icns into their Resources and build-dmg.sh sets it as the disk image's volume icon. No Icon Composer .icon compiled by actool into Assets.car.
- **REL-401** (owner): FERB.app stays within 720 MB (arm64) and 750 MB (Intel), in MB of 10^6 bytes, checked by tests/test_packaging.py MAX_APP_MB.
- **REL-402** (owner): On Intel Macs FERB installs cryptography 48.0.1 (the last release with Intel Mac wheels); every other platform takes the current pin.
- **REL-403** (owner): One FERB.app shipped as two DMGs (Apple silicon, Intel), signed without a Developer ID or notarization for now; updates install by themselves; the notch is the main interface with detail in a regular window; installing from source stays supported.
- **REL-404** (agent): FERB.app never compiles ferb-secrets: build-app.sh ships the arm64 or x86_64 slice of assets/secret-helper/ferb-secrets after scripts/secret_helper.py --check confirms pin.json matches the binary and the helper's code (comments aside). Only a change to the helper's code is rebuilt and pinned again (--build), knowing every saved secret then asks once more on each Mac.
- **REL-407** (owner): Integrate PostHog in the FERB website at the end of its design work, using the owner's project configuration.
- **REL-408** (owner): The disk image opens as a designed Finder window: fixed size, no toolbar or sidebar, large icons, FERB left and the Applications link right with an arrow between, over a still of FERB's startup field (Gravity — Dense) with words in the system font; no text file. Before the Developer ID it says "Drag FERB to Applications" and that macOS blocks FERB the first time (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway); after it (Developer ID, notarized: the variant that stays) only the drag line. The signing identity picks the variant.
- **REL-409** (owner): The whole window (heading, both icons with their names, the first-open note) is visible at once with margins, Finder never scrolls it, and it fits a 1440 x 900 screen with the menu bar and the Dock. The names FERB and Applications read in white on the field.
- **REL-410** (agent): scripts/dmg_layout.py is the one spec. make_dmg_background.py compiles dmg-background/main.swift with the app's StartupStudies.swift and GravityDenseStudy.swift and renders each variant at 1x and 2x into assets/dmg, committed like the logo files (REL-3). build-dmg.sh stages FERB.app, the Applications link, a 1x+2x TIFF background and the volume icon, then dmg_layout.py writes the .DS_Store on the mounted image with ds_store and mac_alias (MIT, pinned dev group), never driving Finder; its alias and bookmark name /Volumes/FERB. FERB_DMG_VARIANT overrides the variant for previews.
- **REL-411** (agent): Finder draws icon labels black over a background picture in any appearance; no view option changes it (macOS 27.2: icvp textColor in any form is ignored). So the background draws the names in white, and Finder's labels, at its smallest size (10), fall on a soft pool of the stage's black under each icon, unseen. Labels to the right scroll the window sideways. WindowBounds is the whole window: the 680 x 440 content plus a 32-point title bar (macOS 26+); on a 28-point title bar the window is 4 points taller than the picture (macOS 15 not checked).
- **REL-412** (owner): ferb.kartikey.xyz is one calm page in the manner of kartikey.xyz (narrow column, system type, thin rules, quiet links), with words from the earlier site; no glass, gradients or notch walkthrough demo. Still held: REL-1's logo and its derived files; only the Apple Silicon DMG with an Apple icon, inactive until the owner gives its URL; the first-open note; /privacy at the same URL; privacy claims keep local storage and redacted context to the chosen AI service, never all-offline AI; PostHog last (REL-407).
- **REL-413** (agent): site/ is index.html, privacy.html and styles.css with the logo files; no JavaScript, build step, web fonts or third-party requests. Light only, as kartikey.xyz is (#fafafa, #333, 520px column, 1.7 line height). Its pixel-font headings become the system monospace, so no font is fetched. The policy keeps its words; only its frame and style changed. vercel.json cleanUrls serves /privacy.
